schedule_contract: Each stream starts empty and completes all three first visits before revisiting an unresolved task. The 0.98 session selects and resumes pending research from actual successor knowledge and the previous purchased evidence. Restore full JSON between visits. After the knowledge arm finishes, the ablation receives only its revisit task positions and allocated resource limits, never its candidate, predictions, source concept identifiers, or candidate scores. Terminal evaluation starts only after all first visits and revisits in all arms of the cohort have ended.
knowledge_ablation_contract: All arms perform the same declared source tasks. The ablation retains the library immediately after each task first ended and uses that task-local snapshot for its matched revisit. It can retain knowledge acquired by its own subsequent revisits of that task, but receives no successor knowledge. candidate=None requests ordinary resumed research through the existing continuation interface. This is a matched-schedule knowledge ablation, not an autonomous scheduler baseline. A paired allocation is always clipped by the ablation stream own remaining total budget; exhaustion is recorded rather than receiving extra resources or silently dropping a task.
budget_contract: The total stream budget is three times the original per-task allowance. First visits retain the original limits. Subsequent work consumes only the remaining stream pool; it is not restricted to the old task unused share. Old purchased observations are restored without buying them again. Source learning, candidate screening and fitting, failed and successful revisits, and all new purchases count. Session totals equal latest cumulative reports summed over unique tasks plus separately charged screening computation; do not add an old report again on top of its resumed cumulative report.
evaluation_contract: Evaluate the latest returned Program for every unique task, including unresolved tasks, using the same independent controls and disturbances per paired stream. The fixed public quantile .9 and pinball loss are the primary risk endpoint. (9,1) action loss is ten times pinball, not independent evidence. Record all terminal resources separately, including the measurement cost of the selected deployment channels.
oracle_contract: Only the terminal scorer uses evaluation_oracle, after every learning and revisit process has finished. Its full-state conditional quantile is a reference; neither it nor any terminal outcome enters scheduling, hypotheses, stopping, or memory.
comparisons: Paired latest-model pinball loss per complete stream and original task stage against 0.97 and the matched no-successor-knowledge arm. Report all three resource totals, query counts, CPU and wall time, actual revisit count/cost, source-knowledge usage, and unresolved outcomes. No binary solved threshold or extra terminal tuning.
scope: Eight prospectively fixed stochastic roots of the existing two noisy mechanisms and parameter profiles, yielding 72 initial task visits plus actual revisits. These are not eight independently parameterized apparatus. Development root 95401903 and the optional known root 95401901 were previously exposed and are not prospective evidence.
execution_contract: Prepare protocol before outcomes. Use explicitly released current source for known development, then freeze the final released 0.98 source before any main learning. Run at most four independent stream processes at once. Preserve failed attempts and negative results; do not tune from the main cohort.
